SUMMARY

DESCRIPTION
**SHARE OF FREEHOLD** We are delighted to welcomed this immaculately presented one bedroom top floor apartment sporting stunning far-reaching city and sea views to the market, situated in a sought-after location. Benefiting from one double bedroom, lounge, kitchen, shower room and private roof terrace.

Located in the desirable location of Plymouth Hoe in the heart of the city, a stone's throw away from the waterfront, historic barbican all whilst being a short stroll to a host of local amenities such as an array of shops and restaurants, the city centre and major transport links.

As you enter this apartment, you are welcomed with a spacious open-plan bright and airy lounge and kitchen giving that contemporary living feel, with modern matching wall and base units and built-in appliances to the kitchen area, a well-presented good-sized double bedroom can also be found as well as a modern shower room comprising walk-in shower, hand basin and W.C. This building also benefits from CCTV and being management by the owners.

Externally, this property boasts it's own private roof terrace, perfect for enjoying in the summer months with beautiful far-reaching views.

This apartment is an attractive opportunity for a first-time buyer or investor with a brilliant rental income and successful Air BnB buisness, appealing to a wide range of buyers.

EARLY VIEWINGS ADVISED!

Lounge 15' 8" maximum x 11' 6" maximum ( 4.78m maximum x 3.51m maximum )

Kitchen 15' 2" maximum x 9' 9" maximum ( 4.62m maximum x 2.97m maximum )

Bedroom 14'  maximum x 11' 10" maximum ( 4.27m maximum x 3.61m maximum )

Shower Room 10' 9" maximum x 7' 5" maximum ( 3.28m maximum x 2.26m maximum )

Agents Note; 
Please note that an AML fee is chargeable to the buyer once an offer is accepted to cover the cost of carrying out the required identity and anti-money laundering checks. Once these checks have been completed, the fee cannot be refunded, even if the property purchase does not go ahead.

We currently hold lease details as displayed above, should you require further information please contact the branch.  Please note additional fees could be incurred for items such as leasehold packs.
